# PeerJ

> PeerJ is an open-access peer-reviewed platform connecting academic researchers, editors, and scientists across biology, medicine, and technology disciplines.

PeerJ hosts researcher profiles and editorial boards featuring experts in fields ranging from entomology and evolutionary biology to biochemistry and RFIC technology. The platform leverages peer review and academic collaboration to advance scientific publishing and research visibility.

## Key Topics

- peer-review
- open-access publishing
- academic research
- researcher profiles
- editor profiles
- entomology
- evolutionary biology
- biochemistry
- ecology
- infectious disease
- animal behavior
- genetics
- DNA repair
- microbiology
- audiology

- [PeerJ Editor - Christopher Jolly](https://peerj.com/ChrisJolly): PeerJ Editor and DNA repair researcher at Centenary Institute

## Researcher Profiles

- [Entomologist - Stephen Smith](https://peerj.com/SteveSmith): Retired entomologist from University of Waterloo specializing in Diptera and bloodsucking insects
- [Evolutionary Biologist - Eduardo Santos](https://peerj.com/EduardoSASantos): Researcher specializing in behavioral ecology and animal behavior
- [Computational Biologist - Matthew Pennell](https://peerj.com/mwpennell): Computational specialist in evolutionary studies and phylogenetic analysis
- [Microbiology Researcher - Ruifu Yang](https://peerj.com/ruifu): Microbiologist from Beijing Institute of Microbiology
- [Epidemiologist - Andrew Byrne](https://peerj.com/AWByrne): Epidemiologist focused on infectious disease and one health approaches
